title: What is generative AI?
teaser: Machines that create, not just recognize

basics.say: Most AI you've met so far recognizes things: it spots spam, reads license plates or tags the people in your photos.
Generative AI goes one step further: it creates something new – an email, a picture, a summary, even a song.
You describe what you want in plain words, and it produces a fresh result that didn't exist a second before.
How? It studied millions of examples and learned what usually goes together – then it builds new content piece by piece.
That's why the same request can give a slightly different answer each time. It's creating, not copying.

deeper.say: Under the hood, generation is prediction. A text model predicts the next piece of text, again and again, until the answer is complete.
Image models work differently: many start from random noise and clean it up, step by step, until a picture matches your description.
A little randomness is built in on purpose. Developers can often tune it – low for consistent answers, high for more creative ones.
It doesn't keep a copy of the internet to paste from. It learned patterns – which is also why it can sound sure and still be wrong.

takeaway: Generative AI creates new content by predicting what fits, based on patterns it learned.
